contact.basis: Original USGS sample at the playing field near the site anchor. Each stand rises from the same field datum.

verticalDatum: USGS 3DEP original elevations in meters; model uses site-relative Y.
attribution: U.S. Geological Survey 3DEP, The National Map
method: Independent original USGS 3DEP GeoTIFF sampled bilinearly in the fixed geographic frame before the model. Original field preserved, including the bowl and hillside.
limitations: The bare-earth source preserves hillside and cut but does not measure individual stadium decks or finished grades.
